title: Duecare Knowledge Builder Playground Wheels
subtitle: Wheels for the knowledge-builder playground - pull web sources or pasted text into new RAG documents
description: v3.16 - wheels for content-knowledge-builder-playground. Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models. Lets a user paste a recent ILO press release, court filing, or NGO report; Gemma 4 extracts citations and writes a new RAG corpus entry that the chat / classifier surfaces can immediately retrieve over BM25. The 33-doc baseline RAG corpus extends in place.
